description: We are devshell, a software development team passionate about building modern, intelligent applications. Our focus spans end-to-end software engineering, clean architecture, and integrating cutting-edge artificial intelligence into practical solutions.
summary: Our project is a browser-accessible trainer with both 2D and 3D options. It gives the user the possibility to create a lunar base, manage resources, deal with different events, and make decisions that will impact the success or failure of the mission.
details: Our project is a platform that gives all learners the opportunity to experience what it is like to manage a lunar outpost. The goal is to make it beginner-friendly, with an incremental learning curve that helps every type of learner understand complex systems without feeling pressured. The project uses a wide range of technologies (typescript, three.js, vite, ... ). Each mission can be different, because every learner builds their own architecture, which provides a variety of options and encourages creativity and experimentation. The project can be discovered and tested by both kids (ages 7-12) and interested adults.
